hooks.name: Ghi log CHANGELOG khi chỉnh sửa src/

action.prompt: A source file in src/ was just saved. Please append a brief changelog entry to docs/CHANGELOG.md describing what was changed. Use format: `- [HH:MM] Chỉnh sửa \`<relative_path>\` — <short description of change>`. Group under today's date heading if it already exists, otherwise create a new date heading `## [YYYY-MM-DD]` with a `### Chỉnh sửa` subsection. Keep the entry concise (1 line).
